description: This file defines the ClaimEventAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing claim events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and listing claim events, utilizing annotations for OpenAPI documentation and implementing various validation rules and business logic.

classes.name: ClaimEventAPI
classes.description: REST API controller for claim event management, including CRUD operations and listing functionalities, with integrated validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClaimEvent instance, setting its name and other properties based on request parameters, and saves it to the database. Returns the created event wrapped in a resource result.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Populates a ClaimEvent entity with description and status from request parameters, associates it with the current authenticated user, and persists it via DAO.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of claim events matching optional search filters and pagination parameters. Returns a collection result with total count metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint query parameters, including optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a claim event, mainly requiring a 'name' and validating optional fields.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs a validation rule for the 'name' property of claim events, ensuring string length and uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: getClaimEventCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates an EntityUniquePropertyOption that ignores certain values (like marked as deleted) when validating uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim events by given IDs after verifying their existence. Returns list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete request payload, primarily validating an array of IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single claim event by ID, checks for existence, and indicates whether it can be edited based on usage status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for fetching a single claim event, mainly validating ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim event, with conditional logic to prevent editing certain fields if used. Applies validated data and persists changes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a claim event, including ID, optional description, status, and name with uniqueness check.
